Name: Frost Blast
Description: You put your arms together, with your palms stretching backward as a flash of ice blasts from your palms, threatening to freeze others in place. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 5d4 cold damage on a failed save, also having their Movement Speed reduced to 0 until the start of their next turn, or half as much damage on a successful one, with their Movement Speed being reduced only to half it's total until the start of their next turn.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 2nd.
